dialogues.speaker: Xiaodong
dialogues.text: How come it's still not here after all this time...?

dialogues.speaker: Xiaodong
dialogues.text: The tea and ore I brought are all sold out. I'm just waiting to load the blankets and spices from Sumeru so I can get back to Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaodong
dialogues.text: It's just those spices I ordered a long while ago that still haven't showed up...

dialogues.speaker: Xiaodong
dialogues.text: My contact could only say they're on the road. I think he's just trying to stall me.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaodong
dialogues.text: It's better to wait at the dock myself.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaodong
dialogues.text: Yeah, hope I'll get my shipment soon.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaodong
dialogues.text: Thanks, hope it'll work out as we expect.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaodong
dialogues.text: I've got some leftover materials after my last deal. Not that they're of poor quality, they're just a few extra pieces. You can take them if you don't mind.
